utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane — just keep me posted when you know more, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I have an update.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it — I’ll wait for your update and plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — I’ll plan for that and meet you there after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll be there tomorrow afternoon with the wrench set and replacement hose. See you at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you tomorrow afternoon — I’ll head over after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ve got the wrench set and replacement hose ready. Swing by tomorrow afternoon if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Leo — tomorrow afternoon works great. I’ll swing by then and appreciate you having the wrench set and hose ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — see you tomorrow afternoon, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — you can borrow both. Just bring them back when you’re done, and let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep everyone posted, and the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the tools and supplies for the gate and shelves first, then I’ll let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. I appreciate you checking the tools and letting me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: You’re welcome — I’ll take a careful look and tell you exactly what’s missing so we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll send anyone interested your way, and I’ll keep asking a few more neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’m keeping track of what everyone can bring, so just send anyone interested my way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll point folks your way and keep spreading the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, let’s wait on the organizer first. If they confirm it, we can tell folks the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds safest — I’ll wait for the organizer’s confirmation before I share anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Let me know once you hear back, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll swing by the repair drive while I’m out and let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — let’s wait for confirmation before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll wait for confirmation and report back once I hear something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive later, see what they still need, and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’d be a big help. Swing by when you can and tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll stop by later, check what the repair drive still needs, and pass along any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great — I can bring a small toolbox and a few spare screws, and I’ll check the shed for any usable wood too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Oren — thank you! I’ll let everyone know we’ve got you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Glad to help — just tell me if anything else is still needed, and I’ll see what I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check what tools and supplies we still need first and let you know. Then we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — thanks, Mara. I’ll keep checking on the drop-off spot and let you know what people think.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Rey — I’ll circle back once I’ve checked the list, and we can fill any gaps before the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still at the community center parking lot on Maple Street, right beside the library entrance. If you’re coming after the school run, Oak Avenue is usually the easiest way in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’m still catching up, so I’ll watch for Rosa’s schedule update and ask Vik what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — if Rosa’s update changes anything, I can point you to the right spot.
